name: Albedo
title: Kreideprinz
description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

skillTalents.name: Favonius Bladework - Weiss
skillTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma
skillTalents.description:
Albedo creates a Solar Isotoma using alchemy, which deals AoE Geo DMG on appearance.

Solar Isotoma
has the following properties:
·When opponents within the Solar Isotoma field take DMG, the Solar Isotoma will generate Transient Blossoms which deal AoE Geo DMG. DMG dealt scales off Albedo's DEF. 
·Transient Blossoms can only be generated once every 2s.
·When a character is located at the locus of the Solar Isotoma, the Solar Isotoma will accumulate Geo power to form a crystallized platform that lifts the character up to a certain height. Only one crystallized platform can exist at a time.
·Solar Isotoma is considered a Geo construct. Only one Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself can exist at a time. 

Hold to designate the location of the skill.

This Geo bloom has an unusual property mirrored in the aim of alchemy. To rise from the earth, soar into the sky, and become the sun.

skillTalents.name: Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide
skillTalents.description:
Under Albedo's command, Geo crystals surge and burst forth, dealing AoE Geo DMG in front of him.
If a Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself is on the field, 7 Fatal Blossoms will be generated in the Solar Isotoma field, bursting violently into bloom and dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Tectonic Tide DMG and Fatal Blossom DMG will not generate Transient Blossoms.

Under the Kreideprinz's command, the tectonic tide of creation seethes into life.

passiveTalents.name: Calcite Might
passiveTalents.description:
Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma deal 25% more DMG to opponents whose HP is below 50%.

Hexerei enhancement
Transient Blossoms generated by the Elemental Skill Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma deal 25% more DMG to opponents whose HP is below 50%.
Additionally, if there is a Silver Isotoma on the field that was created by Albedo, the DMG dealt will also be increased by 240% of Albedo's DEF.

modifiers.label: Transient Blossom DMG against opponents below 50% HP
Hexerei enhancement — Additional Transient Blossom DMG with a Silver Isotoma on the field, based on Albedo's DEF

passiveTalents.name: Homuncular Nature
passiveTalents.description: Using Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide increases the Elemental Mastery of nearby party members by 125 for 10s.

passiveTalents.name: Flash of Genius
passiveTalents.description: When Albedo crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, he has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

passiveTalents.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Book of Blinding Light
passiveTalents.unlock: Complete Witch's Homework: Beyond the Lesson
passiveTalents.description:
After completing Witch's Homework: Beyond the Lesson, Albedo will become a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the Hexerei: Secret Rite effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

Hexerei: Secret Rite
· When Albedo hits an opponent with his Elemental Skill within 20s of using an Elemental Skill, it will generate a Silver Isotoma near the opponent that lasts for 10s. When there are no Solar Isotomas created by Albedo on the field, and as long as Albedo is not downed, a single Silver Isotoma will begin generating Transient Blossoms, just as Solar Isotomas would. There can be up to two Silver Isotomas generated by Albedo on the field at any one time.
· After creating a Solar Isotoma, nearby party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 4% for every 1,000 DEF Albedo has for 20s. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 12%.
· After generating a Silver Isotoma, nearby Hexerei party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 10% for every 1,000 DEF Albedo has for 20s. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 30%.

modifiers.label: Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby party members' Normal Attack DMG after creating a Solar Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF
Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby party members' Charged Attack DMG after creating a Solar Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF
Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby party members' Plunging Attack DMG after creating a Solar Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF
Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby party members' Elemental Skill DMG after creating a Solar Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF
Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby party members' Elemental Burst DMG after creating a Solar Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF
Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby Hexerei party members' Normal Attack DMG after generating a Silver Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF
Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby Hexerei party members' Charged Attack DMG after generating a Silver Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF
Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby Hexerei party members' Plunging Attack DMG after generating a Silver Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF
Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby Hexerei party members' Elemental Skill DMG after generating a Silver Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF
Hexerei: Secret Rite — Nearby Hexerei party members' Elemental Burst DMG after generating a Silver Isotoma, per point of Albedo's DEF

constellations.name: Flower of Eden
constellations.description:
Transient Blossoms generated by Albedo's Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma regenerate 1.2 Energy for Albedo.

Hexerei enhancement
Transient Blossoms generated by Albedo's Elemental Skill Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma regenerate 1.2 Energy for Albedo.
Additionally, the use of Albedo's Elemental Skill Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma also increases his DEF by 50% for the next 20s.

modifiers.label: Hexerei enhancement — Albedo's DEF after using his Elemental Skill

constellations.name: Opening of Phanerozoic
constellations.description:
Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma grant Albedo Fatal Reckoning for 30s:
·Unleashing Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide consumes all stacks of Fatal Reckoning. Each stack of Fatal Reckoning consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms and Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide's burst DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF.
·This effect stacks up to 4 times.

Hexerei enhancement
Transient Blossoms generated by the Elemental Skill Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma grant Albedo Fatal Reckoning for 30s:
· Unleashing the Elemental Burst Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide consumes all stacks of Fatal Reckoning. Each stack of Fatal Reckoning consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms and Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide's burst DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF.
· This effect stacks up to 4 times.

Additionally, when Albedo is not on the field and when the stack count of Fatal Reckoning reaches 4, all stacks of Fatal Reckoning are consumed. This generates 3 Fatal Blossoms near your active character, which will violently bloom to deal AoE Geo DMG equal to 300% of Albedo's DEF, DMG that will be considered Elemental Burst DMG. Where the Passive Talent Homuncular Nature has also been unlocked, the Elemental Mastery of nearby party members will also increase by 125 for 10s.

modifiers.label: Burst cast and Fatal Blossom DMG per Fatal Reckoning stack consumed by casting the Burst, based on Albedo's DEF

skills.label: Hexerei enhancement — One Fatal Blossom generated when four Fatal Reckoning stacks are consumed off-field

constellations.name: Grace of Helios
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Descent of Divinity
constellations.description:
Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field have their Plunging Attack DMG increased by 30%.

Hexerei enhancement
Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field have their Plunging Attack DMG increased by 30%.
Additionally, when a nearby active party member jumps near a Silver Isotoma, the Silver Isotoma will be destroyed while greatly increasing the height of that jump, and for the next 3s, said character will deal 30% more Plunging Attack ground impact DMG. This effect is removed 0.1s after Plunging Attack ground impact DMG is dealt.

modifiers.label: Active character's Plunging Attack DMG within the Solar Isotoma field
Hexerei enhancement — Additional Plunging Attack ground impact DMG only, after jumping near and destroying a Silver Isotoma

constellations.name: Tide of Hadean
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Dust of Purification
constellations.description:
Active party members within the Solar Isotoma field who are protected by a shield created by Crystallize, or when Moondrifts are present within the Solar Isotoma field, have their DMG increased by 17%.

Hexerei enhancement
Current active party members within the Solar Isotoma field who are protected by a Shield created by Crystallize, or when Moondrifts are present within the Solar Isotoma field, have their DMG increased by 17%.
Additionally, use of the Elemental Burst Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide destroys all Silver Isotomas present on the field, and whenever a Silver Isotoma is destroyed this way the current instance of Elemental Burst will also be considered as having cleared 4 Fatal Reckoning stacks from the Constellation Opening of Phanerozoic. This increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossom by 250% of Albedo's DEF for the next 20s.

modifiers.label: Active character's DMG within the Solar Isotoma field, protected by a Crystallize shield or with Moondrifts in the field
Hexerei enhancement — Additional Fatal Blossom DMG after destroying Silver Isotomas with the Burst, based on Albedo's DEF
